Show what the account used and spent over a date window, from Plivo's usage
summary: a row per period, product, type, country and direction, then other
charges (number rentals, lookups, fees, taxes), then the total spend. Answer
spend questions with this, never by adding up call or message records.

--since and --until are UTC dates, YYYY-MM-DD, sent as given. --until is
exclusive: the window ends as that day starts, so --until 2026-11-01 ends with
October 31. Without --since the window is the 7 days before --until; without
--until it runs through today. Plivo caps the window by --granularity (hour 7
days, day 92 days, month 24 months, year no cap) and answers a longer one with
a 400 naming the granularity to use.

--all reads every page of usage rows. The totals and other charges come with
the first page and cover the whole window. --limit 1000 needs the fewest
requests: Plivo allows 20 a minute.

Usage:
  plivo account usage [flags]

Examples:
  plivo account usage --since 2026-10-01 --until 2026-11-01 --granularity month
  plivo account usage --since 2026-10-01 --product voice --direction outbound --all -o json

Flags:
      --all                   fetch every page (stops after 100 pages)
      --country string        two-letter country code, e.g. US
      --direction string      inbound|outbound
      --error-code string     message rows with this error code
      --from-date string      same as --since
      --granularity string    period of a row: hour|day|month|year (Plivo's default: day)
      --hangup-cause string   voice and SIP trunk rows with this hangup cause
  -h, --help                  help for usage
      --limit int             usage rows per page (1-1000) (default 100)
      --product stringArray   only this product: message|voice|zentrunk|transcription|other (repeatable)
      --since string          first day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC)
      --subaccount string     only this subaccount (its auth ID)
      --to-date string        same as --until
      --until string          day the window ends before, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC): exclusive, that day is left out

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json|jsonl|yaml|csv (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
      --query string       JMESPath filter on the JSON output, e.g. 'data.objects[].call_uuid' (implies -o json)
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --schema             describe the command (arguments, flags, output fields) instead of running it
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts
